text:
arjun: heads up — started seeing a burst of reconnects from the EU edge at ~11:04 UTC. clients report duplicate events and billing shows +2 for some streaming sessions.

liz: any obvious error in proxy logs?

matt: paste the resume_id and socket snippet?

arjun: resume_id=rd_7a9f3b, logs: `resume accepted` then immediately `new connection accepted` with same resume_id. no reject in between.

sam: might be routing split during token rotation — seen this race before.

arjun: looks like token rotation triggered reconnect and both conns routed to different upstreams before lease claim.

liz: explains duplicate consumption and double-billing. console aggregates by connection_id; billing path lacks resume_id dedupe.

matt: repro plan: force token rotate on active stream + route-swap on staging. i'll try.

ops-bot: canary deployment 2026-03-23T11:07 rolled to 10% on EU-edge (sha:3bdf4a).

arjun: short-term: add server-side billing dedupe on resume_id and tag telemetry with `resume_race:true`.

sam: also surface a console banner explaining "resume race" to reduce support tickets.

liz: UX question — show "possible duplicate events" in per-session details? avoid alarmism.

matt: two-step: 1) billing dedupe + telemetry tag; 2) make routing claim atomic so only one path accepts resume.

arjun: atomic claim touches LB and shard registry — rollout risk. need canary.

sam: quick guard idea: ephemeral lock in route service on resume accept (TTL=2s) to reject second accepts during TTL. low-effort.

liz: +1. add console flag to enable TTL guard per-tenant while testing.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-1249: "resume race — billing dedupe + short-lived lease guard" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1249

arjun: matt — ping when you have repro logs. i'll start billing dedupe patch and telemetry tag.

matt: repro on staging, logs attached to ticket. noted cluster-wide spike during canary shift.

sam: schedule 30m sync after lunch to decide rollout for lease guard + console flag.

liz: tagging SRE: tune alerts to reduce noise; change threshold to >=5 dup resumes/min.

console-bot: banner draft: "Known issue: brief duplicate stream events can occur during routing handoffs. Rolling mitigations. See INF-1249."

arjun: thanks all, will follow up after sync. :thumbsup:
